about:
Naughton Equipment Company, Inc. operates from Fort Calhoun, Nebraska. The business has accumulated over 40 years of experience serving the meat processing industry, although an exact founding year is not provided in public materials. Information about the company's ownership structure or founders is not disclosed.

The company provides equipment and services tailored to meat, poultry, and fish processors. Its catalog features the E-Z Splitter II carcass splitting saw and deep stainless steel product trucks, along with a broader equipment inventory for sale. Naughton Equipment emphasizes that its products are engineered to increase yields and cut maintenance expenses for processing plants.

Customers come from the meat processing, poultry processing, and fish processing industries. The company's mission statement explicitly names these three sectors as the focus of its equipment design and support activities.

Naughton Equipment says it sets itself apart through a combination of superior equipment design aimed at improving yields and reducing maintenance costs, and a commitment to delivering the best quality service in the industry. The firm attributes its approach to more than four decades of specialized experience in meat processing equipment.
